43252-tessa-our-little-italian-cousin.title: Tessa Our Little Italian Cousin
43252-tessa-our-little-italian-cousin.creator: Mary Hazelton Wade
43252-tessa-our-little-italian-cousin.description: A book by Mary Hazelton Wade. The man was not alone,--Beppo and the donkey were with him. They were very tired, for it was a hard trip from the little village on the hilltop to the great city, miles away, and back again. The donkey was not of much help on the homeward journey, either. Poor little patient beast! he was getting old now, and he felt that his day's work was done when he had carried a load of nuts and vegetables to Rome in the morning.

45398-the-girls-of-friendly-terrace-or-p.title: Or: Peggy Raymond’s Success
45398-the-girls-of-friendly-terrace-or-p.creator: Harriet Lummis Smith
45398-the-girls-of-friendly-terrace-or-p.description: A book by Harriet Lummis Smith. Terrace was a happy accident. It must have been an accident, for Jenkins Avenue crossed it at right angles, and just to the north ran Sixtieth Street. No one could have guessed when the Terrace was laid out that the name would prove so appropriate, and that the comfortable cottages would have such a cordial, neighborly look, as if nodding greetings to one another across their neat strips of lawn.

64595-animat.creator: Unknown

But for the uranium mines of Jupiter's moons they also had begun to create these inexpensive living blends of animate flesh and bone, synthetic moronic creatures.

arxiv-2104-05851.title: Two-atom van-der-Waals forces with one atom excited: the identical atoms limit I
arxiv-2104-05851.creator: J. Sánchez-Cánovas, M. Donaire
arxiv-2104-05851.description: Abstract We compute the conservative van-der-Waals forces between two atoms, one of which is initially excited, in the limit of identical atoms. Starting with the perturbative calculation of the interaction between two dissimilar atoms, we show that a time-dependent approach in the weak-interaction approximation is essential in considering the identical atoms limit in the perturbative regime.

arxiv-2210-13650.title: ReaRev: Adaptive Reasoning for Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2210-13650.creator: Costas Mavromatis, George Karypis
arxiv-2210-13650.description: Abstract Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) involves retrieving entities as answers from a Knowledge Graph (KG) using natural language queries. The challenge is to learn to reason over question-relevant KG facts that traverse KG entities and lead to the question answers.

arxiv-2406-01210.title: ♊ \gemini GeminiFusion: Efficient Pixel-wise Multimodal Fusion for Vision Transformer
arxiv-2406-01210.creator: Ding Jia, Jianyuan Guo, Kai Han, Han Wu, Chao Zhang, Chang Xu 🖂, Xinghao Chen 🖂
arxiv-2406-01210.description: Abstract Cross-modal transformers have demonstrated superiority in various vision tasks by effectively integrating different modalities. This paper first critiques prior token exchange methods which replace less informative tokens with inter-modal features, and demonstrate exchange based methods underperform cross-attention mechanisms, while the computational demand of the latter inevitably restricts its use with longer sequences.

arxiv-2411-00284.title: SimpleFSDP: Simpler Fully Sharded Data Parallel with torch.compile
arxiv-2411-00284.creator: Ruisi Zhang, Tianyu Liu, Will Feng, Andrew Gu, Sanket Purandare, Wanchao Liang, Francisco Massa
arxiv-2411-00284.description: Abstract Distributed training of large models consumes enormous computation resources and requires substantial engineering efforts to compose various training techniques. This paper presents SimpleFSDP, a PyTorch-native compiler-based Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) framework, which has a simple implementation for maintenance and composability, allows full computation-communication graph tracing, and brings performance enhancement via compiler backend optimizations.

arxiv-2412-14930.title: Emergence of unidirectionality and phase separation in optically dense emitter ensembles
arxiv-2412-14930.creator: Kasper J. Kusmierek, Max Schemmer, Sahand Mahmoodian, Klemens Hammerer
arxiv-2412-14930.description: Abstract The transmission of light through an ensemble of two-level emitters in a one-dimensional geometry is commonly described by one of two emblematic models of quantum electrodynamics (QED): the driven-dissipative Dicke model or the Maxwell-Bloch equations. Both exhibit distinct features of phase transitions and phase separations, depending on system parameters such as optical depth and external drive strength.

arxiv-2502-19171.title: PlantPal: Leveraging Precision Agriculture Robots to Facilitate Remote Engagement in Urban Gardening Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’25), April 26-May 1, 2025, Yokohama,
arxiv-2502-19171.creator: Albin Zeqiri, Julian Britten, Clara Schramm, Pascal Jansen, Michael Rietzler, Enrico Rukzio
arxiv-2502-19171.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Albin Zeqiri, Julian Britten, Clara Schramm, Pascal Jansen, Michael Rietzler, Enrico Rukzio. Urban gardening is widely recognized for its numerous health and environmental benefits. However, the lack of suitable garden spaces, demanding daily schedules and limited gardening expertise present major roadblocks for citizens looking to engage in urban gardening. While prior research has explored smart home solutions to support urban gardeners, these approaches currently do not fully address these practical barriers.

arxiv-2508-04290.title: Analysis on a generalized two-component Novikov system
arxiv-2508-04290.creator: Yonghui Zhou, Xiaowan Li, Shuguan Ji, Zhijun Qiao
arxiv-2508-04290.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the Cauchy problem for a generalized two-component Novikov system with weak dissipation. We first establish the local well-posedness of solutions by using the Kato’s theorem. Then we give the necessary and sufficient condition for the occurrence of wave breaking in a finite time.

arxiv-2508-16118.title: Isomorphisms and automorphisms of multiprojective bundles and symmetric powers of projective bundles
arxiv-2508-16118.creator: Ashima Bansal, Supravat Sarkar, Shivam Vats
arxiv-2508-16118.description: Abstract . We describe when two multiprojective bundles (fibre products of projective bundles over the same base) over projective spaces are isomorphic as abstract varieties. We also describe when two relative symmetric powers of projective bundles over projective spaces are isomorphic. Finally, we describe the automorphisms of multiprojective bundles and relative symmetric powers of projective bundles over projective spaces.

arxiv-2512-02617.title: The role of counting quantifiers in laminar set systems
arxiv-2512-02617.creator: Rutger Campbell, Noleen Köhler
arxiv-2512-02617.description: Abstract Laminar set systems consist of non-crossing subsets of a universe with set inclusion essentially corresponding to the descendant relationship of a tree, the so-called laminar tree. Laminar set systems lie at the core of many graph decompositions such as modular decompositions, split decompositions, and bi-join decompositions.

pmc-10595117.title: Maternal healthy lifestyle score and offspring birth outcomes: secondary analyses of the PEARS RCT
pmc-10595117.creator: K Philippe, F M McAuliffe, C M Phillips
pmc-10595117.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe influence of maternal lifestyle behaviours during pregnancy on offspring outcomes has been investigated individually. A composite Healthy Lifestyle Score (HLS) comprising low-risk protective lifestyle behaviours can be useful for studying links between overall lifestyle and health outcomes.

pmc-10702278.title: Negative pressure wound therapy for complex oral wounds
pmc-10702278.creator: Mykaihla Sternick, James C Gates, Allen Champion, Andrew Yampolsky
pmc-10702278.description: Negative pressure wound therapy provides a nonsurgical treatment option for many types of complex wounds. This therapy utilizes the vacuum-assisted closure device, which decreases air pressure, removes fluid that accumulates within the wound, and aids to facilitate changes that promote healing.

pmc-12491736.title: Green lentil fortification of wheat bread: a strategy for quality improvement and acrylamide reduction☆
pmc-12491736.creator: Vytaute Starkute, Elena Bartkiene, Ernestas Mockus, João Miguel Rocha, Darius Cernauskas, Erika Mozuriene, Romas Ruibys, Gul Ebru Orhun, Dovile Klupsaite
pmc-12491736.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study aimed to assess how non-treated (N), milled (M), and with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum fermented (F) green lentils affect the quality and safety parameters, including volatile compound (VC) profile and acrylamide (AA) concentration, of wheat bread (WB). The overall acceptability (OA) of WB with 5, 10, 15, and 20% lentils, as well as with 25% the non-M F and N non-F lentils was similar to that of the control.

pmc-12576853.title: MUSCLE STRENGTH AND STIFFNESS OF ELBOW MUSCLES: CORRELATION WITH UPPER LIMB MOTOR FUNCTIONS IN PEOPLE WITH CHRONIC STROKE
pmc-12576853.creator: Shamay SM NG, Peiming CHEN, Shun Hei CHOI, Tung Ji LAM, Hei Yee LAU, Hing Ki LAU, Ho Yeung LAW, Desmond YW LAM, Cynthia YY LAI
pmc-12576853.description: ObjectiveTo (i) quantify elbow flexor and extensor strength and stiffness in people with stroke; (ii) compare affected and unaffected sides; (iii) compare stroke survivors and healthy older adults; and (iv) examine correlations between muscle properties, motor control, and ADLs.DesignCross-sectional study.Participants65 stroke survivors and 31 healthy older adults.MethodsElbow muscle strength and stiffness (biceps and triceps) were assessed bilaterally by Myoton PRO.

pmc-12738574.title: Penicillium chrysogenum originated chloro-diydropyridyl-oxopropanimidic acid derivative as a potent EPSP synthase-targeted bioherbicide against invasive weed species
pmc-12738574.creator: Saeed Ullah Khattak, Sajjad Ahmad, Ayesha Saleem, Basmah F. Alharbi
pmc-12738574.description: Fungi are prolific producers of bioactive metabolites, some of which exhibit herbicidal activity and may serve as sustainable alternatives to synthetic herbicides. In this study, an endophytic Penicillium chrysogenum was investigated for metabolite production. A pure compound, identified as 2-((5-chloro-4-oxo-4, 5-dihydropyridin-3-yl) amino)-3-oxopropanimidic acid (C₈H₈ClN₃O₃; exact mass 229.

pmc-12751423.title: Evaluation of foreign bodies in the maxillofacial region with cone beam computed tomography and ultrasonography: an ex vivo study
pmc-12751423.creator: Kubra Taka, Umut Pamukcu, Gulsun Akay, Yeliz Kilinc, Ilkay Peker
pmc-12751423.description: BackgroundWhen foreign bodies in the human body are not diagnosed (detected), it can cause various inflammatory reactions. Therefore, they should be detected and removed immediately. Taking a detailed patient history, performing a clinical examination, and selecting the appropriate imaging method are important for detection. The location, structure, and size of the foreign body affect the choice of radiography technique.

pmc-13062753.title: Third Delivery in a Chinese Patient With Anomalous Origin of Left Coronary Artery From Pulmonary Artery (ALCAPA): A Case Report
pmc-13062753.creator: He Zhao, Dawei Zhang, Yanna Li, Zhen Fang, Nan Zhang, Jun Zhang
pmc-13062753.description: BackgroundAnomalous origin of the left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery (ALCAPA) is a rare congenital defect that poses a significant risk of myocardial ischemia and sudden death, especially during the hemodynamic stresses of pregnancy. Although surgical correction is standard, the management of asymptomatic adult‐type ALCAPA diagnosed during pregnancy remains a high‐stakes clinical challenge.

pmc-13520594.title: Dynamic phenotyping of radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer: thyroglobulin trajectories, dual-modal imaging, and genotype-defined treatment resistance
pmc-13520594.creator: Gongxun Tan, Yue Zhang, Zhenwei Mao, Chuan Zhang, Jingjing Fu, Feng Wang, Canhong Zhu, Jin Zhou, Bingquan Jin, Ying Xu, Rong Qin, Xun Shao, Lele Zhang, Shaohua Li, Qian Gu
pmc-13520594.description: BackgroundRadioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer (RAIR-DTC) is a clinically aggressive disease state with limited treatment options. While individual biomarkers, imaging modalities, and genomic drivers have each been studied in isolation, the dynamic relationships among longitudinal thyroglobulin kinetics, evolving dual-modal imaging phenotypes, and underlying genotypes, together with their consequences for targeted therapy response, remain insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13580996.title: Turning a phage anti-defense weapon into an immunity trigger
pmc-13580996.creator: Anna B. Adelstein, Naama Aviram
pmc-13580996.description: Most bacterial immune systems raise an alarm when they sense a phage. A new study in PLOS Biology shows how type II Panoptes reverses this logic by maintaining a quiet signal and sensing infection through its sudden disappearance. In the last decade, our understanding of bacterial defense mechanisms against phages has surged with hundreds of independent defense systems discovered [1–4].
